thread:
maya_sales: Heads-up: OrionPay wants a migration POC from CompetitorX next Tue. Key asks: prompt/stop-token parity, token-billing reconciliation, rate-limit mapping (they currently see 10k rps bursts), and the standard security questionnaire. Who owns what? cc @zach_se @nina_se

zach_se: I can lead the technical POC. Need sample payloads and their streaming format. Do they rely on deterministic stop-token chunking?

maya_sales: Yes 1: they send `session_id` header + ordered `messages` array and assume identical chunk boundaries for delta clients. Uploaded SQ and sample prompts to Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/ORION/POC

ben_solutions: I'll build a small proxy shim to normalize headers and emit newline-delimited JSON chunks to match their client. Example shim config: `{ "map_headers": {"x-client-session":"session_id"}, "stream_mode":"ndjson"}`. Will attach Docker compose + curl demo.

leo_research: FYI model/tokenizer choice matters for stop-token alignment. Start with rwd-2-small tokenization family for parity tests; escalate to larger sizes if needed. Quantization may shift boundaries.

nina_se: I'll own the SQ. Need to confirm retention policy options and KMS/HSM support. Maya please share legal contact.

maya_sales: Shared legal contact. Buyer asked for a token-parity guarantee vs CompetitorX. How to respond?

ada_pm: We cannot guarantee exact billed tokens (different tokenizer/formatting), but offer a billing reconciliation during the POC: run their corpus on both sides, produce a delta report, and agree a remediation window if delta > 5%. Wording: "billing reconciliation and remediation support during migration".

zach_se: For parity SLOs propose: "response-fidelity regression <=1% on customer-provided evals during migration month" + remediation plan. I'll run a parity harness and share results by Fri.

security_bot: SQ quick list: SOC2, E2E TLS, RBAC, audit logs, KMS integration, retention options (30d default, 0d for Dedicated/Private). Docs: https://security.redwood.ai/sq

ben_solutions: Demo curl (compat endpoint): `curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/compat -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'x-client-session: 1234' -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}],"stream":true}'` Expect NDJSON chunks with `event: chunk`.

maya_sales: Plan: POC doc by EOD Fri, SQ answers Thu, parity smoke by Fri, demo Tue. Owners: Zach (parity), Nina (SQ), Ben (proxy). Confirm?

zach_se: Confirmed. Parity harness results by Fri EOD.

nina_se: Confirmed. SQ responses Thu noon.

ben_solutions: Confirmed. Sandbox demo ready.

maya_sales: Thanks all 1. I'll update the customer and share calendar invites.
